_comment: slug -> real titles. The slug is the raw filename without .json, which is
what extract.js derives book_slug from. Loaded as DATA into
staging.book_manifest so corpus.collections carries the correct Arabic
title on FIRST insert -- 10_dimensions.sql deliberately refuses to patch
titles afterwards, because a later UPDATE nobody runs leaves the corpus
Titles are taken verbatim from the `book` field inside the records.
unnumbered_label: a book whose numberless records are real content, not
front matter. Sahih Muslim's 40 numberless records are its Muqaddimah (the
introduction): 28 reports about narrators and 12 passages of Imam Muslim's
own prose. The extractor keeps them and numbers them '<label> 1' .. '<label> N'
in source order. A book without the key drops numberless records, as Bukhari
must: its 135 are bab headings and verse glosses (issue #18).
